The '''Corrdair system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Hevvrol sector/Legends|Hevvrol sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corrdair]].
